decisions.reason: As a publicly announced flagship with a dedicated new business unit in an expanding market, offshore vessel management carries high sunk and reputational commitment, so management is likely to persist with it.
Crew and corporate travel management is close to the core service portfolio, and any weak recent performance could still be justified as temporary disruption rather than a reason to reverse course.

The online vessel information portal was presented as a flagship, so visible strategic commitment and likely development investment make management inclined to continue rather than admit a mistaken push.

The mobile vessel performance app is adjacent but not publicly central, so if uptake has been modest it is the easiest offering to discontinue because less has to be justified and less commitment is written off.
